mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outreach_script (id, script_id, customer_id, rm_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, channel, objective, opening_line, talking_points, risk_reminders, closing_line, follow_up_action, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{script.scriptId}, #{script.customerId}, #{script.rmId}, #{script.operatingCaseId}, #{script.journeyId}, #{script.channel}, #{script.objective}, #{script.openingLine}, #{script.talkingPoints, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.TalkingPointListTypeHandler}, #{script.riskReminders, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{script.closingLine}, #{script.followUpAction}, #{script.createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{script.createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT script_id, customer_id, rm_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, channel, objective, opening_line, talking_points, risk_reminders, closing_line, follow_up_action, created_at FROM outreach_script WHERE script_id = #{scriptId}

SELECT script_id, customer_id, rm_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, channel, objective, opening_line, talking_points, risk_reminders, closing_line, follow_up_action, created_at FROM outreach_script WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}

SELECT script_id, customer_id, rm_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, channel, objective, opening_line, talking_points, risk_reminders, closing_line, follow_up_action, created_at FROM outreach_script WHERE operating_case_id = #{operatingCaseId}

SELECT script_id, customer_id, rm_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, channel, objective, opening_line, talking_points, risk_reminders, closing_line, follow_up_action, created_at FROM outreach_script WHERE journey_id = #{journeyId}
